name: Sikkim (royal flag, 1877–1967)
description: An elaborate flag with a wide orange border of cloud patterns around a white field bearing a red-rimmed Buddhist wheel (khorlo) surrounded by religious emblems, with a red inner border.
history: Reconstruction of the flag of the Kingdom of Sikkim adopted in 1877, when the Chogyal's kingdom first took a flag of its own: the khorlo of Sikkim within a profusion of Buddhist emblems and an ornamental border. Because it was so difficult to reproduce, a simplified white flag with the khorlo and a red border was adopted in 1967.

features.role: khorlo, the Buddhist wheel of law
